defs.def: with or near to sb/sth else; with each other 在一起；共同

ex.s: “The exhibition brings together Go culture, cutting-edge technology and contemporary art,” says Tu.
ex.t: "这次展览汇集了围棋文化、前沿技术和当代艺术，"涂说。

ex.s: At first, everything went wrong — the plastic broke, the printer jammed, and the pieces didn’t fit together.
ex.t: 几周后，我又去了农场。

ex.s: When enough of these errors are averaged together, they cancel each other out, resulting in a more accurate estimate.
ex.t: 当足够多的这类误差被平均在一起时，它们会相互抵消，从而得到更准确的估计。

ex.s: Tackling the odds together cures.
ex.t: 共同面对困难治愈一切

ex.s: An easy way to bring all work generations together is with a chat platform
ex.t: 让各年龄段职场人聚在一起的一个简便方式是使用聊天平台

ex.s: Only at dinnertime are we eating together anymore，74 percent，according to statistics from the report.
ex.t: 只有晚餐时我们才会聚在一起吃饭——74%，根据该报告的统计数据。

ex.s: Alone，but together，you know？”Bechtel said，looking up from her book.
ex.t: “你明白的，虽然独自一人，但也在一起。”Bechtel从书本上抬起头来说。

ex.s: Money not tied together.
ex.t: 没有捆绑在一起的钱。

ex.s: We both became absorbed in the simplicity of playing together.
ex.t: 我们俩都沉浸在一起玩耍的简单快乐中。

ex.s: Sometimes neighbors may go to the supermarket together to do shopping.
ex.t: 这里有一些小建议可以帮助你迅速赢得社区所有人的好感

ex.s: Today, the Longji Rice Terraces attract thousands of visitors who come to admire this great wonder created by people and nature working together.
ex.t: 如今，龙脊梯田吸引成千上万游客前来欣赏人与自然共同创造的这一伟大奇迹。

ex.s: Memories of their 67-year life together would always make her smile.
ex.t: 对他们67年共同生活的回忆总会让她露出微笑。

ex.s: The best housewarming parties encourage old friends to get together.
ex.t: 最好的乔迁派对能让老朋友聚在一起。

ex.s: The Chinese characters “gōng” and “hé” together mean “work together, cooperate.” The original term — gõngyè  hézuòshè — means Chinese Industrial Cooperatives.
ex.t: 他印象深刻地说："……所有士兵都将自己致力于同一个理念，并共同努力实现这一理念。"然后他开始在海军陆战队中使用"工合"一词来试图创造他所见证的那种精神。

ex.s: Are you looking for a way to bring your family together?
ex.t: 你在寻找一种让家人凝聚在一起的方式吗？

ex.s: In a matrix garden, plants with similar cultural needs are grouped so that they will grow together above and below ground, forming a cooperative ecosystem that conserves water and discourages weeds.
ex.t: 在矩阵花园中，养护需求相似的植物被组合在一起，使它们在地上地下共同生长，形成一个节约用水、抑制杂草的协作生态系统。

ex.s: The most rewarding day for our group was project day，when all the efforts we put into collecting the items finally came together．When I saw the various supplies we had collected，it hit me that every kit we were to build that day would eventually be in the hands of an Iraqi child．Over the past four months，I had never imagined how I would feel once our project was completed．While making the kits，I realized that I had lost sight of the true meaning behind it．I had only focused on the fact that it was another school project and one I wanted to get a good grade on．When the kits were completed，and ready to be sent overseas，the warm feeling I had was one I would never forget．
ex.t: 对我们小组来说最有收获的一天是项目日，那天我们为收集物资付出的所有努力终于汇聚在一起。当我看到我们收集到的各种物资时，我突然意识到，那天我们要制作的每一个套装最终都会送到一个伊拉克孩子手中。在过去的四个月里，我从未想象过项目完成后自己会有怎样的感受。在制作这些套装的过程中，我意识到自己已经忽略了它背后的真正意义——我只顾着把它当成又一个学校项目，而且是我想要拿高分的一个。当这些套装制作完成、准备送往海外时，那种温暖的感觉我将永远铭记。

ex.s: People have been working together to record its migration and make sure that there are enough plants for it to feed on.
ex.t: 人们一直在共同努力记录它的迁徙，并确保有足够的植物供它觅食。

ex.s: The real McNay was splendid， but we felt nervous the whole time we were there． Van Gogh， Picasso． This time， we stayed together， in case anything else unusual happened．
ex.t: 真正的麦克奈庄园很华丽，但我们在那里的整个时间都很紧张。梵高、毕加索。这次，我们待在一起，以防再发生什么不寻常的事。

ex.s: Hotpot is meant for families and friends to sit together, dip everything they like this in one pot, and shared friendship and love.
ex.src: 2024全国甲卷·第四部分 写作
ex.t: 火锅适合家人和朋友围坐在一起，把自己喜欢的东西都放进同一个锅里蘸着吃，分享友谊和爱。

ex.s: Discover, explore and enjoy award-winning Tullie House, where historic collections, contemporary art and family fun are brought together in one impressive museum and art gallery.
ex.t: 探索、欣赏Tullie House这个获奖场所，这里将历史收藏、当代艺术和家庭乐趣汇集在一个令人印象深刻的博物馆和美术馆中。

ex.s: Paul and I didn’t see each other all that regularly, but sharing that brought us together.
ex.t: 保罗和我见面并不频繁，但这种共同的理念把我们紧紧联系在一起。

ex.s: Paul and I didn’t see each other all that regularly, but sharing that brought us together.
ex.t: 保罗和我见面并不频繁，但这种共同的理念把我们紧紧联系在一起。

ex.s: "It is curious that no one has put together a history of both the steam and electric revolutions." writes Maury Klein in his book The Power Makers, Steam, Electricity, and the Men Invented Modem America.
ex.t: 奇怪的是，竟没有人把蒸汽和电气两次革命的历史合在一起写，莫里·克莱因在《造电者：蒸汽、电力与发明现代美国的人》一书中写道。

ex.s: Most frequently, the groups reported that they “shared arguments and reasoned together.” Somehow, these arguments and reasoning resulted in a global reduction in error.
ex.t: 最常见的情况是，这些小组报告说，它们“分享论点，共同推理”。 不知何故，这些论点和推理导致全球误差减少。

ex.s: Phone carriers and consumers need to work together to find ways of determining and communicating what is real.
ex.t: 电话运营商和消费者需要共同努力，找到方法来辨别并传达什么是真实的。

ex.s: So for them to move to Elkhead, Colo. to instruct the children whose shoes were held together with string was a surprise.
ex.t: 因此，她们搬到科罗拉多州埃尔克黑德，去教那些鞋子用绳子绑在一起的孩子，令人意外。

defs.def: so that two or more things touch or are joined to or combined with each other 以使接触（或相结合）；到一起

ex.s: It felt great to know that I had helped bring this family together again.
ex.t: 知道自己帮助这个家庭重新团聚，感觉太棒了。

ex.s: several vaccines are used together
ex.t: 为了讨论治疗麻疹的方法。

ex.s: The fake reviews written for Azimi’s study were put together by humans, but increasingly, fake reviews are being written by AI, which makes them look more real.
ex.t: Azimi研究中使用的虚假评论由真人编写，但越来越多的虚假评论正由人工智能撰写，这使它们看起来更加真实。

ex.s: Some might assume morality and happiness naturally go together.
ex.t: 即使是最专注最投入的听众最终也会感到厌倦。

ex.s: So I’ve put together some good tips for starting an art journey.
ex.t: 因此，我整理了一些开始艺术之旅的好技巧。

ex.s: Museums are working together with AI ethicists to develop fair algorithms.
ex.t: 博物馆正与人工智能伦理学家合作，开发公平的算法。

ex.s: Ideally a history would bring together texts and objects, and some chapters of this book are able to do just that, but in many cases we simply can’t.
ex.t: 理想情况下，历史会把文本和实物结合起来，本书的一些章节能够做到这一点，但在许多情况下我们根本做不到。

defs.def: in a close relationship, for example a marriage 两个人

ex.s: Her final goal is to link the worlds of art and science back together: She believes that bringing the old recipes to life can help develop a kind of learning that highlights experimentation, teamwork, and problem solving.
ex.t: 她的最终目标是把艺术与科学这两个世界重新联系起来：她相信，让古老配方“活”起来，有助于发展一种强调实验、团队合作和解决问题的学习方式。

defs.def: in or into agreement 一致；协调

ex.s: They worked together in “Ragtime”.
ex.t: 他们曾合作出演《爵士时代》。

defs.def: at the same time 同时；一起；一齐

ex.s: I took down one of the dictionaries, and we read it together for a few minutes before I handed it to him.
ex.t: 我取下其中一本词典，我们一起读了几分钟，然后递给了他。

ex.s: We laughed together, often, but from the stories we’ve shared about ourselves, I know I’m not the only one who faces life’s challenges.
ex.t: 我们一起笑，常常笑，但从我们分享的关于自己的故事里，我知道面对生活挑战的不止我一个。

ex.s: We played games together, and stayed up late reading bedtime stories.
ex.t: 我们一起玩游戏熬夜读睡前故事。

ex.s: To have a meal together.
ex.t: 一起吃饭。

ex.s: Families can enjoy the experience together, too, with Family Camp programs for families with children as young as 7.
ex.t: 家庭也能一起享受这种体验，因为有为7岁以下儿童家庭准备的"家庭营"项目。

ex.s: They often get up earlier and water the vegetables together.
ex.t: 他们经常起得很早，一起浇菜。

ex.s: They often get up earlier and water the vegetables together.
ex.t: 他们经常起得很早，一起浇菜。

ex.s: We started to practise together and soon became friends.
ex.t: 我们开始一起练习，很快就成了朋友。

ex.s: Mr Dena occasionally gave partner tests, believing that we could solve hard problems together.
ex.t: Dena先生偶尔会给合伙人做测试 认为我们可以一起解决难题

ex.s: Then I can spare some time to learn it again, such that we can practice together on every day.
ex.t: 然后，我可以腾出一些时间再次学习它，这样我们就可以每天一起练习。

ex.s: When he walked in, the boy shouted proudly, “Hey, that's my bus driver!”They went into a quiet corner and began reading together.
ex.t: 当他走进去时，男孩骄傲地喊道："嘿，那是我的校车司机！"他们走进一个安静的角落，开始一起读书。

ex.s: For those wishing to park near friends, all vehicles must have passes for the same zone and arrive together — spaces cannot be saved.
ex.t: 对于想把车停在朋友附近的人，所有车辆必须持有同一区域的停车证并同时到达——车位不能预留。

ex.s: The two belong together.
ex.t: 我也从未见过同时拥有这两种品质的普通人。

ex.s: Amazingly, the trees grow in such a way that their leaves and branches, although close together, never actually touch those of another tree.
ex.t: 令人惊奇的是，这些树的生长方式使它们的叶子和树枝虽然靠得很近，却从不真正碰到另一棵树的叶子和树枝。

ex.s: Barcelona has put together a package of clean energy technologies to help public transportation go greener, while also doing its part to tackle climate change and aid Europe’s difficult shift to the privately owned electric vehicle market.
ex.t: 巴塞罗那已经汇集了一整套清洁能源技术，以帮助公共交通走向绿色，同时也在应对气候变化并帮助欧洲艰难地转向私人拥有的电动车辆市场方面尽了自己的职责。

defs.def: for hours, days, etc. without stopping 接连 … 地；连续 … 地； … 不间断地

ex.s: Just like a mint that creates coins, there' s only one place on the island where the shells, which are polished and strung together to form 3-foot-long ropes, are made.
ex.t: 就像铸币厂制造硬币一样，岛上只有一个地方制作这种贝壳——它们被抛光并串成3英尺长的绳子。

ex.s: In the coming months, we are bringing together artists form all over the globe, to enjoy speaking Shakespeare’s plays in their own language, in our Globe, within the architecture Shakespeare wrote for.
ex.t: 在接下来的几个月里，我们将汇聚来自全球各地的艺术家，在我们的环球剧场、在莎士比亚当年写作时所设计的建筑中，用他们各自的语言来演绎莎士比亚的戏剧。

ex.s: In the coming months, we are bringing together artists form all over the globe, to enjoy speaking Shakespeare’s plays in their own language, in our Globe, within the architecture Shakespeare wrote for.

defs.def: in addition to; as well as 加之；和；连同；同 … 一起

ex.s: Skilled at putting up shelves and piecing together furniture, she never pays someone else to do a job she can do herself.
ex.t: 她擅长安装架子和拼装家具，从不花钱请别人做自己能做的事。

ex.s: It takes sentences from its library of documents and prebuilt arguments and strings them together.
ex.t: 它从自己的文档库和预先构建的论据中提取句子并将它们串联起来。

ex.s: She moved their family from Canada to California when she was one year old, because he wanted them to explore a new place together.
ex.t: 在她一岁时，她把全家从加拿大搬到了加利福尼亚，因为他想让他们一起探索一个新地方。

ex.s: Campers will share their colorful ideas and imagination with each other and work together to visualize, sketch and paint with non-traditional techniques to create the coolest mural which will be displayed in public for all to see.
ex.t: 营员们将彼此分享他们多彩的想法和想象力，并合作通过可视化、素描和非传统技法进行创作，画出最酷的壁画，这幅壁画将在公共场合展出供所有人观看。

ex.s: What can you do together with Javier Marin?
ex.t: 你可以和哈维尔·马林一起做什么？

ex.s: She gathered friends, learned some basic programming, and together they created an app that maps small local parks and gardens few people knew about.
ex.t: 她召集了朋友，学习了一些基础编程知识，然后一起创建了一款应用程序，绘制出很少有人知道的当地小公园和花园的地图。

ex.s: Then I put the tomatoes and the beaten eggs into pan together.  ＂Not that way，＂ my mom tried to stop us but failed.
ex.t: 然后我把西红柿和打好的鸡蛋一起放入锅中。"不是那样，"妈妈试图阻止我们但没成功。

ex.s: Official reports suggest that the number of households with three generations living together had risen from 325,000 in 2002 to 419,000 in 2013.
ex.t: 官方报告显示，三代同堂的家庭数量从2002年的325,000户增加到2013年的419,000户。

ex.s: He and I were raised here in New York, just like two brothers, together.
ex.t: 他和我都是在纽约这里长大的，就像两兄弟一样，形影不离。

ex.s: Our life story is something that starts coming together in our teenage years, when we begin to organise our lives into chapters around key events or life changes, and begin to see ourselves as both the central character and, to a varying extent, the story’s author.
ex.t: 我们的人生故事在青少年时期开始成形，那时我们开始把生活围绕关键事件或人生变化整理成一个个章节，并开始把自己视为故事的中心人物，并且在不同程度上也视为这个故事的创作者。

ex.s: Four years ago they all moved into a three-storey Victorian house in Bristol — one of a growing number of multigenerational families in the UK living together under the same roof.
ex.t: 四年前，他们全都搬进了布里斯托尔一栋三层维多利亚式住宅——这是英国越来越多几代人同堂、住在同一屋檐下的家庭之一。
